components.note: 戈 (halberd) — a weapon radical, as in 战 war and 成. 我 began as a picture of a jagged-bladed weapon; the pronoun "I" is a later borrowing of the sound.
亻 (person) — marks words about people, as in 你 you, 他 he, 做 do. Here it shows 们 pluralises person words (我们, 他们).
门 (mén) gives the sound: 们 is men (neutral tone), the same syllable as 门 gate.
十 (shí, ten) is a loose sound clue for 什 (shén, shí in 什锦); old sense "a set of ten", hence "assorted". In 什么 it is simply "what".
口 (mouth) — knowing is something you can say aloud; 口 sits in many speech words (问 ask, 告 tell).
矢 (shǐ, arrow) is only a loose sound clue today; the same 知 sound is in 智 zhì (wisdom).
辶 (walk) — movement and roads, as in 这 this, 过 pass, 近 near; a 道 is a road, then a way or principle.
首 (shǒu, head) is only a loose sound hint for dào; 首 also means "head/first", fitting a lead-the-way road.
亻 (person) — marks people, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 做 do; 他 is "he" (or other).
也 (yě) is only a loose sound hint for tā; the sibling 她 tā (she) shares it with 女 for woman.
一 (one) — a single horizontal stroke is the number one; 二 and 三 just add strokes, so the first three numbers are tally marks.
亻 (person) — marks people, as in 他 he, 们 plural, 住 live; 你 is "you".
尔 (ěr) is a loose sound clue for nǐ; 尔 also supplies 您 nín (polite you, with 心 added).
氵 (water) — liquids and flowing; 没 first meant sink or submerge (淹没), which led to "gone" and then "not have".
殳 (shū) is only a loose sound hint for 没 (méi/mò); it also sits in 设 shè and 投 tóu.
月 (flesh/meat, not moon here) — oldest form is a hand holding a piece of meat, "to possess"; 月 as meat also appears in 肉 words like 肚 belly and 脑 brain.
辶 (walk) — movement and place, as in 道 way, 过 pass, 近 near; the radical hints at "here / this way". The 文 part is not a useful sound clue.
心 (heart) — feelings and thought, as in 想 think, 思 ponder, 急 anxious; in 怎 it is only loosely linked to the question sense.
乍 (zhà) is a loose sound clue for zěn; 乍 also sounds out 作 zuò, 昨 zuó and 炸 zhà.
王 (jade) — on the left, 王 is the jade radical, as in 球 ball, 玩 play, 理 reason; jade is bright and shows itself.
见 (jiàn, see) is a close sound clue (xiàn) and also fits the meaning: appear so it can be seen.
土 (earth) — ground and place, as in 地 earth, 坐 sit; 在 is "to be at a place".
才 (cái) is a close sound clue for zài; 才 also appears in 材 cái.
口 (mouth) — speech or assent: to say "OK". 可 is also a famous sound part: 河 hé, 歌 gē, 哥 gē, 何 hé all take their sound from it.
女 (woman) — women and family terms, as in 妈 mom, 好 good, 姐 sister; 女 (nǚ) also loosely echoes the rú sound.
口 (mouth) — speech; 如 originally meant "to follow, accord with", later "as, like"; also in 汝 rǔ and 茹 rú.
木 (tree) — trees and wood, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; the fruit hangs on the tree.
田 (field) here is the round fruit drawn on the tree. 果 also gives the sound for 课 kè and 颗 kē.
木 (tree) — wood, as in 桌 table, 板 board; 样 once meant a tree (acorn) and later "form, pattern".
羊 (yáng, sheep) is a near-exact sound clue for yàng; 羊 also sounds out 洋 yáng and 养 yǎng.
口 (mouth) — speaking, as in 说 say, 问 ask; 告 is "to tell". 告 also gives sound to 造 zào and 靠 kào.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — words and language, as in 说 say, 请 please, 谢 thank.
斥 (chì) is only a loose sound hint for sù.
囗 (enclosure) — here a mat; oldest form shows a person 大 lying on a mat, "to rely on", later "cause". 因 also sounds out 姻 yīn and 烟 yān.
自 (self) — picture of a nose; Chinese speakers point to the nose to mean "I", so it became "self" (compare 鼻 bí, nose, which adds 畀).
田 (field) — farmland, the village's fields.
土 (earth) — land; field + earth gives "village" and then the unit of distance. 里 is the sound part of 理 lǐ.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 住 live.
旦 (dàn) gives the exact sound; 旦 also sounds out 担 dān and 胆 dǎn.
日 (sun) — on top; the usual explanation is sun over 正 "straight, correct": what is clear and straight is "right, is". A memory aid, not firm etymology.
日 (sun) — day and time, as in 晴 clear, 早 early, 明 bright; time was read from the sun.
寸 (cùn) stands in for 寺 sì in the traditional 時; sound clue is loose. 寺 also gives 诗 shī and 持 chí.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 住; 候 means to wait for someone.
侯 (hóu) is a close sound clue for hòu; it also gives 猴 hóu monkey and 喉 hóu throat.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and cloth, as in 红 red, 给 give, 级 level; 经 first meant a warp thread, then "classics, pass through".
巠 (jīng), here simplified to look like 圣, gives the same sound; also in 茎 jīng, 径 jìng and 轻 qīng.
讠 (speech) — words, as in 说, 请, 诉: you thank someone with words.
射 (shè) is a loose sound clue for xiè; in 谢谢 the tone drops to neutral on the second.
见 (see) — seeing and perceiving, as in 现, 看, 视: 觉 is to sense and become aware (jué), also "sleep" (jiào) in 睡觉.
The top is a shape of 学 (xué), a loose sound hint from the traditional 覺.
彳 (step) — walking and going, as in 行, 往, 很 very.
寸 (hand) — oldest form is a hand grabbing a cowrie shell (money): 得 is "to obtain". The shell has worn down to 旦.
儿 (legs, person) — with a foot 𠂉 above: a foot stepping out in front of a person, so "first, earlier".
土 (earth) — a green shoot pushing up from the ground: growth, birth, life. 生 also sounds out 性 xìng, 姓 xìng and 星 xīng.
壴 (zhù, drum) — a drum on top of 口 mouth: music and singing, joy.
口 (mouth) — singing and speaking, as in 唱 sing, 吃 eat.
欠 (yawn, open mouth) — breath and mouth actions, as in 歌 song, 吹 blow.
又 here replaces 雚 (huān) in the traditional 歡, so it is only a stand-in; same shorthand in 观 and 劝.
能 (can) — originally a picture of a bear, a strong animal (熊 xióng adds fire 灬); "strong, able" gave "can".
雨 (rain) — weather, as in 雪 snow, 雷 thunder, 零 zero. Oldest form: a person waiting out rain; waiting turned into "need".
而 (ér) is only a loose sound hint here; 需 also sounds out 须 xū.
要 (want, need) — oldest form shows hands at a waist: it meant "waist" (腰 yāo adds 月 flesh); "essential" followed.
白 (white, bright) — 的 first meant bright and clear, as in 的确 dí què.
勺 (sháo) is a loose sound clue for dì; 勺 also sounds out 约 yuē and 钓 diào.
阝 on the right is 邑 (city) — places, as in 都 capital, 邮 post, 部 part. 那 was a place name before it meant "that".
东 (east) — simplified from 東; a common memory aid is the sun 日 caught in a tree 木 at sunrise.
西 (west) — traditionally a bird settling on its nest at sunset, hence west; 西 turns up in 要 and 栖.
讠 (speech) — words, as in 说, 请, 谢: 该 is what one ought to say or do.
亥 (hài) is a close sound clue for gāi; 亥 also sounds out 孩 hái, 核 hé and 刻 kè.
